results.content: According to The Information, Tesla has told staff it is targeting a public Cybercab debut in Austin as soon as the end of August 2026, though the date remains an internal target and could shift as final validation work continues. The plan describes a two-step opening: first, employee rides on public roads — a step up from the private-road employee rides that began around Tesla's Austin campus in July 2026 — then integration of the Cybercab into the Robotaxi service that has been serving public [...] There are also unverified reports from Tesla sales staff, circulating in owner communities, suggesting freeway access and significantly larger geofences may soon come to Robotaxi services in Aus
